project_info.theme: The most beautiful car is the one full of family love
project_info.color_palette: White, soft beige, leafy green, orange, blue

main_subject.detail: A warm family-home poster with large text across the top reading 'CHIEC XE DEP NHAT LA CHIEC XE CO Dau an CUA GIA DINH'. A blue elephant mascot in an orange shirt stands left with arms crossed. On the right, a white MPV is parked in a residential driveway with its tailgate open. The trunk is full of family objects: teddy bear, soccer ball, water bottle, handbag, blanket, kids drawing, and children's shoes on the ground. A child's drawing is also taped to the rear door. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'. Toyota logo is top right.
main_subject.style: Photoreal home-lifestyle automotive poster with sentimental family props and friendly mascot support

composition_elements.text: CHIEC XE DEP NHAT / LA CHIEC XE CO / Dau an / CUA GIA DINH / TOYOTA / Move your world
